invariants.rationale: The method always returns the result of HoodieJavaTable.create, which should not be null if creation succeeds.
The create method returns a HoodieJavaTable instance.
config is used in the method, so it cannot be null at exit without causing a NullPointerException.
context is dereferenced in the method, so it must be non-null at method exit.
The returned object is always a HoodieJavaTable or a subclass thereof.
